stories.title: Eight charged after collapse costs investors £251m
stories.summary: The SFO says the collapse of London Capital & Finance Plc lost investors an estimated £251m.

stories.title: Arsonist jailed for police station petrol bombing
stories.summary: Stacey Pearson threw three petrol bombs at Ashford Police Station, setting fire to three vehicles.

stories.title: Oil clean-up continues as beaches remain closed
stories.summary: Warning signs are in place on beaches from Minnis Bay in Birchington to Ramsgate Main Sands.

stories.title: 'I have gigs in my Kent garden'
stories.summary: Cheryl Baker has a busy few months ahead and it kicks off with her autobiography.

stories.title: Port workers build school shelter and polytunnel
stories.summary: Port of Dover staff donate a working day a year to help local causes including schools and a church.

stories.title: Campaigners fight to save coach routes facing axe
stories.summary: Campaigners start a petition and both an MP and a university ask National Express to reconsider.

stories.title: Controversial housing development delayed again
stories.summary: Concerns are being raised about whether woodland on or next to the site in Kings Hill is ancient.

stories.title: Warning as electric bike and scooter incidents rise
stories.summary: Air Ambulance Charity Kent, Surrey and Sussex says the number of serious collisions is growing.

stories.title: How Kent may have inspired Orwell's Animal Farm
stories.summary: The county should be proud of its links to the famous author, a local historian tells the BBC.

stories.title: Body found on French beach after attempted Channel crossing
stories.summary: The man was found after authorities stopped and overloaded dinghy leaving the beach overnight.

stories.title: Police officers injured in unmarked car crash
stories.summary: They were responding to an emergency when their vehicle was involved in a collision with a van, say police.

stories.title: Tracey Emin plan for derelict Margate pavilion approved
stories.summary: The Kent town's Westbrook Loggia is set to become an arts and community hub, with a sauna and cafe.
